name: iCapital
description:
The iCapital Connector enables advisors to securely access and explore alternative investment holdings data from iCapital directly within Claude. Using natural-language questions, advisors can quickly retrieve information about client holdings, valuations, transactions, and metrics.
 
By combining Claude's conversational interface with data from iCapital, advisors can spend less time searching for information and more time preparing for client conversations, reviewing alternative investment holdings, and understanding holding-level performance and account activity.
 
Important Information
Access to and use of iCapital data through this connector remain governed by any agreement with, or click-through terms, platform terms of use, or disclaimers presented by, iCapital, which may be updated from time to time. Data accessed through this connector may be processed, stored, retained, or otherwise used in accordance with the third-party provider's terms and privacy policies, which are independent of iCapital.
 
AI-generated responses, analyses, summaries, recommendations, and other outputs are produced by third-party systems and may be inaccurate, incomplete, outdated, or misleading. Such outputs are not reviewed, approved, or endorsed by iCapital and should not be relied upon without independent verification. 
 
Any output produced by third-party systems derived from iCapital data should be reviewed by a qualified professional prior to dissemination or finalization. Users are responsible for complying with any applicable disclosure requirements regarding the use of artificial intelligence.
 
iCapital does not control and is not responsible for the operation, security, performance, availability, or continued support of this connector or any AI-generated output. Access to data, data categories, and connector functionality may be modified, restricted, suspended, or discontinued at any time.

_published_faq.name: How do I add iCapital to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add iCapital to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://s.icapitalnetwork.com/icapital/api/v1/icapital-mcp/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the iCapital MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: iCapital provides these MCP tools: query_positions and whoami.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to iCapital?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to iCapital in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
iCapital requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
iCapital is developed by iCapital. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
